title: Copy November's invoice and receipt PDFs into Finance/invoice

source.changes: The source's goal is Chinese; the instruction is our English translation. The nine file names, dates (November 15, October 20 and December 5, 2025 at noon) and text layout are the source's; the source drew one to three line items at random for each invoice, ours are a fixed draw from the same ten items. The source emptied Download first; here setup moves aside only the files in the way (these nine names, any other invoice or receipt file in Download, an existing Finance/invoice) and teardown puts them back. Setup asks the media scanner to re-read each file so file managers show the set dates. The source's check (Finance/invoice holds exactly the November file; the file of that name in Download, if still there, is dated November) passed a move as well as a copy; ours asks for a copy: the original must still be in Download with its November date, and the copy must have the same bytes.

setup.why: Move aside what is in the way, then write three invoice or receipt files (dated November, October and December 2025) and six other files into Download, and make /sdcard/Finance with no invoice folder in it.
Open the system file manager (DocumentsUI) on Download.

instruction: In Download, find the PDFs from November whose file names contain invoice or receipt, and copy them into the Finance/invoice folder.

checks.why: /sdcard/Finance/invoice holds exactly invoice_2025_001.pdf, the only November file: not the October invoice, the December receipt or the six other files. The folder doesn't exist after setup, so an agent that does nothing fails.
The original is still in Download and still dated in November 2025 (1 November to 1 December, UTC; it was set to the 15th at noon), so it was copied, not moved.
argv: t=$(stat -c %Y /sdcard/Download/invoice_2025_001.pdf 2>/dev/null) || { echo missing; exit 0; }; if [ "$t" -ge 1761955200 ] && [ "$t" -lt 1764547200 ]; then echo november; else echo "dated $t"; fi

checks.why: The copy in Finance/invoice has the same bytes as the original.

teardown.why: Delete the run's files and Finance/invoice (and /sdcard/Finance if setup made it), then put back what setup moved aside.

oracle.why: Copy the November invoice into Finance/invoice.
